subject: ANGL
title: Anglais A3 (3e année)
source: Fiche de progression harmonisée nationale A3, 2026/2027

chapters.title: Module 1 – Using language to talk about social integration (traditions and customs of Cameroon) and conflict resolution

lessons.title: Situation 1: Participating in traditional and cultural manifestations (simple past of regular verbs)
Situation 2: Socialising with friends and neighbours while celebrating special occasions (relative pronouns)
Situation 3: Participating in conflict resolution efforts in the family (past tense of irregular verbs)
Situation 4: Participating in conflict resolution efforts in the school environment (present perfect)

chapters.title: Module 2 – Using language to talk about future professional life and participating in leisure activities

lessons.title: Situation 1: Preparing for and undergoing a short, simple job interview (passive and active voices)
Situation 2: Sharing interests in and enjoying entertainment products (modals and their equivalents)
Situation 3: Identifying and discussing recreational activities (phrasal verbs with put, look, give)
Situation 4: Practising recreational activities (making suggestions)

chapters.title: Module 3 – Using language to talk about the protection of the environment and the fight against endemic and pandemic diseases

lessons.title: Situation 1: Discussing the prevention of bush fires and the felling of trees (noun phrases)
Situation 2: Protecting endangered species of animals (comparatives and superlatives)
Situation 3: Finding out about and fighting against endemic diseases (exclamations)
Situation 4: Finding out about and fighting against pandemic diseases

chapters.title: Module 4 – Using language to talk about gender issues and mutual acceptance

lessons.title: Situation 1: Being a victim of gender discrimination or harassment (possessive adjectives)
Situation 2: Participating in gender equality promotion activities (possessive pronouns)
Situation 3: Exploring problems of violence (universal pronouns)
Situation 4: Volunteering for conflict resolution issues (adverbs of degree)

chapters.title: Module 5 – Using language to explore ICTs

lessons.title: Situation 1: Finding out about modern inventions (question tags)
Situation 2: Exploring modern inventions (phrasal verbs)
Situation 3: Worrying over ICT illiteracy (modal verbs)
Writing friendly e-mails or texts about ICTs (modal verbs, revision)
